children: BANAN REAL ESTATE COMPANY SJSC - SUBSIDIARY SIGNS CONTRACT WITH ARMAH SPORTS COMPANY
BANAN: CONTRACT VALUE IS SAR 110.4 MILLION
BANAN: UNDER THIS AGREEMENT, UNIT SHALL DEVELOP THE LAND IT OWNS FOR DEVELOPMENT OF A FULLY EQUIPPED, OPERATIONALLY READY SPORTS CLUB
BANAN: TWO PARTIES ALSO AGREED THAT ARMAH SPORTS CO SHALL LEASE THE SPORTS CLUB UNDER A LONG-TERM LEASE AGREEMENT FOR 20 YEARS
